references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the tribes of Reuben and Gad promised to go armed ahead of the Israelites, which is confirmed in this verse.
Moses sets the condition that they must cross the Jordan armed before the Lord for war, as the servants now confirm they will do.
Moses reminds the tribes of their promise to go armed ahead of their brothers into battle.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh to fulfill their promise to go armed ahead of their brothers.
The fulfillment of the promise: The children of Reuben, the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed the Jordan armed before the Israelites.
Joshua confirms that the tribes have kept their promise and sends them home after the land has been taken.
